## Safety & Compliance Checklist
- [ ] **Tests pass**: All backend and frontend unit tests pass locally.
- [ ] **No real patient data**: Only synthetic test data is used; no real patient records, names, or national IDs.
- [ ] **No secrets**: No API keys, credentials, or production tokens are committed.
- [ ] **Wording rules respected**: Insights use decision-support phrasing (e.g., "worth reviewing"), no prescriptive diagnosis or dosages.
- [ ] **UI matches /design**: Tokens, typography, severity indicators, and components match `/design` reference exactly.
- [ ] **Sources present**: Every clinical insight carries a verifiable document and page source citation.
